mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 53 degrees down by Harriet Park, with a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.
In city news, fall leaf collection officially begins on October 5. Please remember to place loose leaves behind the curb and keep them clear of obstacles like hydrants and mailboxes.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia both taking place today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Verona Fall Fest tomorrow.
In police news, on September 5, officers responded to reports of cheese being placed on car windshields across town, which they identified as part of a viral social media prank.
If you are looking for a snack, please note that Culver's is closed this morning but will be open for business today at 10:00 AM.
